products.title: The Douglas
products.body_html:
Color: Navy Blue Vest

Outstanding feel and flexibility in our Top-of-The-Line Puffer Vest.
Designed for warmth and comfort, without the bulk of traditional
puffers. The quilted front insulates, while the smooth side and back
panels create a clean, streamlined look allowing for easy movement.
Finished with a full-zip front, stand collar, and zippered hand
pockets, it’s a fine outerwear piece built to transition seamlessly
from the golf course to everyday wear.
Key Features
• Navy Blue featuring our Highland Cow Logo on the back yoke
• Incredibly soft, premium hand feel
• Lightweight insulated puffer construction
• Smooth flexible back
• Full-zip front closure
• Zippered hand pockets
• Clean, modern athletic fit
